text.title: Quit Day Job Trigger Contract Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the quit-day-job contract: a header with the version, the commit date, the post_hoc flag and a change log; a trigger on net MRR from a named billing-provider report with a threshold and at least 3 consecutive month-ends; a runway co-condition with the savings, burn (including tax, insurance and business costs), the date they were computed and the months floor R; concentration and churn gates; a reversal clause whose MRR threshold is strictly below the trigger with a window of at least 2 months and a runway floor; a conclusion naming the action, the date rule, the notice period, who is informed in what order and evidence links that resolve to the provider report or the runway model with the month-end they cover; and reviews at the stated cadence whose entries carry the month-end readings, runway, gate values and a verdict. Validator at scripts/validate-quit-day-job-trigger-contract.py enforces it, including the reversal hysteresis, the runway arithmetic, the post_hoc rule against the first qualifying reading, the review date and the verdict against the readings.

required.field: `version` semver, `committed_on`, `post_hoc` true when first committed after a qualifying month-end, `change_log[]` with `version`, `date`, `reason` for every bump (r-precommit-before-threshold)
`min_months` R, `savings`, `monthly_burn` with `burn_includes` self_employment_tax, health_insurance and business_costs, `computed_on`, `months` = savings / burn (r-runway-co-condition)
`mrr_below` strictly lower than the trigger threshold, `consecutive_month_ends` at least 2, `runway_below_months` (r-reversal-hysteresis)

`statement`, `action` resign, `date_rule`, `notice_period_days`, `inform_order[]`, `evidence_links[]` each {url, kind provider_mrr_report / provider_export / runway_model, covers_month_end} (r-conclusion-is-dated-action, r-evidence-is-provider-export)

`cadence` monthly or quarterly, `last_run_at` = the latest entry, `entries[]` each with `run_at`, `readings[]` {month_end, net_mrr}, `runway_months`, `top_customer_share`, `gross_churn_monthly`, `verdict` not_fired / window_in_progress (with `window_count`) / fired / reversal_triggered (r-quarterly-review-records-readings)

forbidden.pattern: `trigger.metric` other than net_mrr, a spreadsheet as `provider`, or a reading that differs from the provider's month-end report — fm-01-gross-cash-as-mrr
`trigger.consecutive_month_ends` below 3, or a `fired` verdict with fewer qualifying consecutive readings than that — fm-02-single-month-fires
a `change_log` entry dated inside a window in progress, or `post_hoc` false when `committed_on` is after the first qualifying month-end — fm-03-threshold-moved-in-window
`reversal.mrr_below` at or above `trigger.threshold`, or a reversal window below 2 month-ends — fm-04-reversal-equals-trigger
`monthly_burn` without self_employment_tax, health_insurance and business_costs in `burn_includes`, or `months` that is not savings / burn — fm-05-runway-ignores-tax-and-insurance
missing gates, or a `fired` verdict while `top_customer_share` or `gross_churn_monthly` exceeds its gate — fm-06-one-customer-is-the-mrr
a review entry without `readings`, or `review.last_run_at` moved by such an entry — fm-07-review-without-readings

an evidence link that is not the provider report, a dated export or the runway model, or one with no `covers_month_end`; a conclusion without a date rule, notice period and inform order (r-evidence-is-provider-export, r-conclusion-is-dated-action)

example.note: Net MRR from the Stripe report with a 3-month-end window; 40,600 over a 3,100 burn that includes tax, insurance and business costs is 13.1 months against a floor of 12; the reversal at 3,000 for 2 month-ends sits below the 4,000 trigger; committed 2026-02-01, before the first qualifying reading of 2026-06-30, so post_hoc is false; the September review carries three consecutive readings above 4,000 with both gates inside their limits, so the verdict fired is what the numbers say.

Gross cash from a spreadsheet with a one-month window; a burn that ignores tax, insurance and business costs; gates set to 1 (no gate); a reversal equal to the trigger with a one-month window and a zero runway floor; "quit when ready" with no date rule, notice or inform order; a screenshot as evidence; a review with no readings that claims fired while one customer is 71 percent of MRR and churn is 9 percent; and a contract committed three days after the big month without the post_hoc flag.

list.item: `trigger.metric` is net_mrr from a named provider report; `consecutive_month_ends` is at least 3.
`runway_co_condition.months` = savings / monthly_burn, the burn includes tax, insurance and business costs, and the date they were computed is printed.
`reversal.mrr_below` is strictly below `trigger.threshold` and its window is at least 2 month-ends; gates are stated as fractions.
`header.committed_on` precedes the first reading at or above the threshold, or `post_hoc` is true; every parameter change is a `change_log` entry with a reason.
The conclusion names the action, the date rule, the notice period and the inform order; every evidence link is the provider report, a dated export or the runway model with the month-end it covers.

Every review entry carries readings, runway and gate values; `last_run_at` equals the latest entry; a `fired` verdict has N consecutive qualifying readings, runway at or above R and both gates inside their limits.

text.reference: Validator implementing this schema and the cross-field rules (runway arithmetic, reversal hysteresis, post_hoc against the first qualifying reading, last_run_at against entries, verdict and window count against the readings and gates).
